responsibility: rustc_interface is the compiler’s top-level embedding and execution layer: it turns external configuration into a fully initialized rustc session, drives the major compilation stages through queries and passes, and exposes the public entry points that tools and the rustc driver use to run the compiler. The crate root in lib.rs assembles and re-exports this interface, including startup and query APIs such as run_compiler, setup_callbacks, Queries, Linker, and default providers, and registers the crate’s fluent diagnostics. interface.rs defines the main Compiler-based interface itself, including Config-driven session construction, parsing of interface-level options like --cfg and --check-cfg, initialization of the codegen backend, lint store, and locale resources, and entry points for executing compilation work and reporting query stacks on failure. passes.rs implements the orchestrated front-end and analysis pipeline that this interface runs, covering parsing, early lints, crate configuration and expansion, resolver and global context creation, interface-level validation and test hooks, and handoff into code generation. queries.rs provides the lazy driver objects that own and cache the major compilation stages for Compiler clients, including parsed inputs, global-context setup and finalization, and the Linker workflow that completes backend work, saves incremental state, and performs or suppresses final linking according to session outputs. util.rs supplies shared startup and output-management utilities that support this orchestration, including target cfg injection, compilation thread and session-global setup, codegen backend loading, crate-type and output validation, output filename computation, and version reporting. callbacks.rs installs the cross-crate global callbacks that let lower-level compiler components consult the active type or query context for span tracking, diagnostics, and debug formatting while safely degrading when TLS state is absent. proc_macro_decls.rs contributes query support specific to proc-macro crates by locating the proc-macro declarations item and registering the corresponding provider. errors.rs centralizes the structured diagnostics used by this layer for interface-specific validation and reporting, including command-line, output-file, proc-macro, MIR-emission, and #[rustc_error] cases. tests.rs validates this public interface behavior with unit tests for option parsing, session and configuration construction, and dependency-tracking hash semantics. Together, these pieces make rustc_interface the stable boundary that initializes compiler infrastructure, connects high-level driver code to lower-level compiler queries and passes, and manages a compilation from configuration through analysis and linking.
